Let $x$ be the time it takes Grandma to walk 1 mile on the beach.  Then $2x$ is the time it takes her to walk 1 mile on the sidewalk.  Since Grandma walks 3 miles on the beach, she spends $40$ minutes walking on the beach.  Thus, $40 = 3x$, so $x = \frac{40}{3}$.  Since $2x$ is the time it takes her to walk 1 mile on the sidewalk, she spends $2 \cdot \frac{40}{3} = \frac{80}{3}$ minutes walking on the sidewalk.  Thus, Grandma spends $40 + \frac{80}{3} = \frac{160}{3}$ minutes walking the entire 3 miles.  The answer is $\boxed{160}$. The answer is 160
